paragraphs.text: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load. 修好打不开的 DSH 会话文件。
# dsh-session-surgeon
Copy a session ID from the sidebar ⋯ menu, then paste it into a new chat so the new session can lear
n from the old one — the Codex-style “continue from this thread” move that stock DSH does not expose
from the old one — the Codex-style “continue from this thread” move that stock DSH does not expose.
Also repairs DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load — seq gap, torn zstd, a zero-filled tail
after the last committed frame (#9372: the crash landed between `write()` and `fsync()`, so the file
's length reached disk without the frame data and the official reader refuses the whole log at `inva
lid frame magic` while every committed frame is intact — we name the boundary and drop the zeros), `
llm/retry` attempts that do not sequence inside their policy chain (#9163: `llm/retry skips its poli
cy attempt sequence`, written silently and surfacing only as `stored session is corrupt` on the next
open — we renumber each chain from 1 and unify its `retryId`, both read back out of the log), lone
surrogates, events missing their message id, and `assistant/message` / `assistant/attempt` rows whos
e settlement fields the seed/restore gate refuses (#8084: `seed assistant/message at index N has inv
alid settlement fields` — we name the row and which of `turn`/`step`/`stream` tripped, then repair i
t: `turn`/`step` from the pair the log has open at that seq, and a missing `stream` as an empty arra
y, the one value both gates admit, leaving `message.content`, `usage` and the replay state untouched
one value both gates admit, leaving `message.content`, `usage` and the replay state untouched [长行截断]

## Why copy the session ID
Stock DSH session ⋯ only has rename / fork / archive. There is no “copy ID”.

1. Left sidebar, click ⋯ on a session → **复制会话 ID**

The ID is the durable handle (with or without the `session-` prefix — same session). Fork duplicates
a file; copying the ID lets a **new** session refer to the old one, the way people pass a Codex thr
ng the ID lets a **new** session refer to the old one, the way people pass a Codex thread id around.
## Install
**DSH Desktop** (the app this repo is developed against since 2026-09-29): open the **Plugins** page
and add the upstream git package `github:xiaoshenming/dsh-session-surgeon#main`. The profile lives
in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, and pnpm resolves `#main` to a commit tarball there. The Desktop shell
(bundled `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend@0.2.0-rc.2`) is what serves the `sidebar.panellist` / `main
` seats this plugin registers into, so 会话医生 is a real sidebar row and a real center-column page — th
e same container the shipped Plugins page uses — rather than a DOM overlay.
The same install from a CLI profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then:

- Session ⋯ menu: **复制会话 ID** (the everyday action) / inspect / dry-run repair
- Sidebar **会话医生 / Se
ssion surgeon**: browse conversations, copy id, dry-run repair, apply repair, compact preview, expor
urgeon**: browse conversations, copy id, dry-run repair, apply repair, compact preview, export JSONL
**Updating** is the Plugins page's update action for this plugin (pnpm re-resolves `#main` to the ne
w commit), or from the profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
No `dsh web` restart and no re-`add` — the installed copy is a plain pnpm checkout without a `.git`
of its own, so push to `main` first and update after.
For local development, use the pinned dsh version and pnpm lockfile (Node.js 24):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`DSH_HOME` keeps development sessions separate; the panel/CLI follow it (`$DSH_SESSION_ROOT` → `$DSH
_HOME/sessions` → `~/.dsh/sessions`) and the panel's *session root* picker lists every DSH home it c
an find on the machine (by home shape, plus any path you type), so sessions in the other home are on
e click away. Avoid reinstalling this checkout with npm: duplicate physical copies of `@deepseek-ai/
dsh-tools` can make tool calls fail with `reading 'prepare'`.

## Also: repair unloadable sessions
Real crash families from official Discussions:

- #317 stack overflow on huge history
- #1497 / #1586 `seq gap in committed region`
- #436 lone UTF-

## Commands
| command | meaning |

| `scan [root]` | list sessions + header health + orphan `.tmp` |
| `inspect <id>` | decode every zs
td frame, expand packed rows, report seq gaps / missing ids / dangling tool/call / steps after a clo

sed turn |
| `repair <id>` | default `--dry-run`; `--apply` rewrites after `.bak.<utc>` |
[该节后续省略]
## What this is not
Not a marketplace, not a token heatmap, not a memory plugin, not a Codex task store.
DSH has **session id + optional same-session goal id**, not a Codex-style resumable task id. Copying
the session ID is the closest everyday equivalent. See docs/LEARNING-TASKS.md.

rows, when the official loader refuses
